column1: # PCI vendor names, as a fallback for when pci.ids is not installed.
#   id    the four hex digits sysfs reports in /sys/bus/pci/devices/*/vendor
#   name  a short form, not the legal entity — "Intel", not "Intel Corporation".
#         Panel width is scarce and nobody reads a suffix twice.
# The real database is pci.ids, shipped by the hwdata package: /usr/share/hwdata on
# Fedora and Arch, /usr/share/misc on Debian. Where it exists it wins, because it names
# the *device* as well as the vendor and is updated by someone whose job that is.
# It is frequently absent — a minimal container has no reason to carry 1.6 MB of device
# names, and neither debian:stable-slim nor fedora:latest ships it. So this table exists
# to keep the graphics and network panels useful in exactly the environments the smoke
# matrix runs in. It deliberately covers only vendors whose parts show up in a display
# or network slot; anything else falls through to the raw hex ID, which is enough to
# Data as of: 2026-08-02. PCI vendor IDs are permanent once assigned, so this ages far
# better than the other tables here — the risk is omission, not staleness.
